subject: Storing output from handle_hover() or handle_click()

messages.author: f71a3e227a790268
messages.subject: Storing output from handle_hover() or handle_click()
parts:
Hey all, 
I was just wondering if there would be a way of storing the output printed to the console from overing over the graph, ideally i am hoping to use this to link two plots in a shiny app via a key

Example code:

library(ggvis)
mtcars$id <- seq_len(nrow(mtcars))

hoveron<-function(data,...){
  testval<-str(data)
}


mtcars %>% ggvis(~mpg, ~wt,key:=~id) %>% layer_points() %>%
  handle_hover(hoveron)


hoping to be able to store the id value of the point which is being hovered over in testval.

Many thanks!
